item.title: Constitutional Court declares Computer Misuse Act null and void
item.description: The Constitutional Court has brought relief to many Ugandans after declaring the Computer Misuse (Amendment) Act, 2022 null and void. In its ruling, the court found that Parliament passed the bill on September 8, 2022 without complying with Rule 24(3) of its Rules of Procedure, which requires verification of quorum before any vote on legislation.
